image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of the head and upper jaw of a Nile crocodile. The image focuses on the textured, armored skin (scutes) around the eye and snout. The mouth is slightly open, revealing several large, conical teeth interlocking with the lower jaw. The eye is visible with a vertical slit pupil. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is an extreme close-up of the side of the head/snout. The full triangular shape and V-profile relative to an alligator cannot be determined from this cropped perspective.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Several large, conical teeth are clearly visible. The fourth tooth of the lower jaw appears to fit into a notch/interlock with the upper jaw, consistent with crocodile anatomy. The texture of the jawbone is rugged and massive.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned high on the skull (dorsal). The pupil is a distinct vertical slit. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed but the eye structure is anatomically correct for a crocodilian.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tip of the snout where nostrils would be located is outside the frame or obscured by the angle of the close-up.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck region are visible; the full body length and armor pattern along the spine cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture shows distinct, raised, bony plates (scutes) with deep crevices, characteristic of crocodilian osteoderms. While 'longitudinal rows' are hard to trace fully in a crop, the local arrangement is consistent.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of sandy beige, grey, and brown tones. The texture is extremely rough, cracked, and detailed, matching the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) side is not visible in this dorsal/lateral close-up.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Skin surface around the eye and snout
artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture is hyper-detailed, almost resembling cracked dry earth more than biological tissue in some areas. While realistic for a crocodile, the uniformity of the 'cracked mud' pattern across different scale types suggests slight AI over-sharpening or texture synthesis repetition, though it remains within plausible biological variance for a dried-out specimen.

artifact_observations.location: Lower jaw edge near the front teeth
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the gum line and the teeth is slightly soft and indistinct in the foreground. The geometry of the jawbone seems to merge slightly with the teeth roots rather than having a clean socket definition, a common minor artifact in AI generation of complex organic interfaces.

To verify the structural integrity of the teeth sockets and ensure no melting/fusion between the teeth and the jawbone.

Analysis of skin texture realism vs. procedural noise
